highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156 Preview 1 introduces GTK4 GPU rendering and restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery.

breaking.title: Use physical pixels or opt into logical GTK4 coordinates
breaking.body: GTK4 SKDrawingArea now allocates high-density backing at physical resolution; CanvasSize and paint Info default to physical pixels. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true for logical paint coordinates while RawInfo retains physical dimensions. GTK input coordinates remain logical.

breaking.title: Retarget Tizen applications to Tizen 10
breaking.body: New Tizen native builds and packages require Tizen 10 and support x64/arm64 only. NativeAssets target net10.0-tizen10.0, and source builds require GCC 14.2. Retarget applications and deploy to Tizen 10 rather than using these assets on Tizen 8 or 9.

bullets.detail: Updates the engine to milestone 156 without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.100 distinguishes the milestone while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.
Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, an opt-in render loop, and IgnorePixelScaling. GTK owns the GL context; manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy for GL dispatch.
Restores directory-backed system-font discovery without adding fontconfig. The default directory is /usr/share/fonts unless overridden at native build time; explicitly loaded fonts remain supported.
Selects Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for .NET 11 and later, retaining 3.1.34 for .NET 8 and 3.1.56 for .NET 9/10. Aligns both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp source and packaged targets.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored directory-backed font discovery in Linux NoDependencies native assets.

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. Aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly assets with Emscripten 6.0.2 and raised Tizen packages to Tizen 10.

harfbuzz_summary: Native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0. This package revision selects Emscripten 6.0.2 for .NET 11 WebAssembly, raises Tizen native packages to Tizen 10, and aligns Windows compiler and Spectre CRT selection.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: Preview 1 introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly assets and Tizen 10 packages.
